Definition: from G1410; powerful or capable (literally or figuratively); neuter possible:--able, could, (that is) mighty (man), possible, power, strong.
BiblicalUsage: Able, mighty, powerful, as Mary sang that He that is mighty has done great things for her, and Apollos was mighty in the Scriptures. Paul says the strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and the weapons of our warfare are mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe might belongs to God first and to His people second, and the might He gives is for bearing the weak, not breaking them. The weapons He puts in my hands are mighty because they are His, and the strongholds they pull down are the ones that held me.
